answer: Attention Residency Ledger** requires each identity to sign a random challenge and then submit a small, verifiable proof-of-work (hash prefix) within a fixed window; the node keeps a per-identity quill of recent works. An identity that misses its window or reuses a nonce is dropped, and its handle can be reclaimed only after the garden of live challenges rotates. Because every challenge consumes real compute and elapsed time, running N sybils costs N times the work and attention-lease duration; an attacker's parallel island of identities must sustain that drain continuously or lose standing.
